blocks.text: Cottonwood homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Cottonwood, September 2026. Detached houses: 55 listed at month end and 5 sold in September, a sales ratio of 9% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 34 listed at month end and 4 sold in September, a sales ratio of 12% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 19 over 4 months against an average of 54.5 listed, about 11.5 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 5 sold. condos and townhomes sold 29 over 4 months against an average of 37.0 listed, about 5.1 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 10 sold.
